    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Board
    Represents the game board for the brick-dropping game.
    Brick
     
    BrickGenerator
     
    BrickRotator
    Handles rotation of a brick by tracking its current rotation index and providing the next rotated shape.
    ClearRow
    Represents the result of clearing completed rows from the game board.
    DownData
    Encapsulates the result of a brick moving down in the game.
    EventSource
    Enum representing the source of a game event.
    EventType
    Enum representing different types of game events in Tetris.
    GameController
    The GameController class handles the game logic for Tetris, including user input, brick movement, collision checking, ghost piece calculation, scoring, and updating the GUI.
    GameOverPanel
    GameOverPanel represents the UI panel displayed when the game ends.
    GuiController
    GuiController manages the visual representation of the Tetris game.
    HighScoreManager
    Handles loading and saving the solo-mode high score to disk.
    HoldEvent
    Represents an event where a Tetris piece is held.
    HoldShapeInfo
    Represents the information of a Tetris piece that is held in the hold slot.
    InputEventListener
    Interface for handling input events in the Tetris game.
    Main
    Main entry point for the Tetris JavaFX application.
    MainMenuController
    Controller for the main menu screen.
    MatrixOperations
    Utility class for matrix operations in the Tetris game.
    MoveEvent
    Represents a movement event for a Tetris brick.
    MusicPlayerWav
    A simple WAV music player that can play and loop background music.
    NextShapeInfo
    Represents the next Tetris piece that will appear in the game.
    NotificationPanel
    A panel that displays temporary notifications, such as score bonuses, with a fade-out and upward movement animation.
    RandomBrickGenerator
     
    Score
    Represents the player's score and the number of lines cleared during the game.
    SimpleBoard
    Represents the Tetris game board with the current state of bricks and game logic.
    VersusController
    Controller for the local versus mode (two-player Tetris).
    ViewData
    Holds the data necessary to render the current Tetris piece and the next piece in the UI.
